content.text: [Slack #support-ops alice Mon Apr 01 10:00 UTC 2026] Morning team. We need to run the monthly SLA compliance analysis for Q4 2024. Tickets are in `tickets/tickets_batch_2024Q4.json`. Policy is v1 in `policy/sla_matrix_v1.json`. Our plan is Atlassian Enterprise: L1=30min, L2=2h, L3=8h, L4=24h.
Confirmed. I will use `policy/sla_matrix_v1.json` as the authoritative SLA source: L1=30min, L2=120min (2h), L3=480min (8h), L4=1440min (24h) under the Atlassian Enterprise plan.
[Slack #support-ops bob Mon Apr 01 10:15 UTC 2026] Quick question on L1 — I thought the response time was 1 hour for Enterprise? I'm looking at an old email from last year saying L1=1h.

Bob, the current Enterprise L1 SLA is **30 minutes** (24/7) per `policy/sla_matrix_v1.json` and the official Atlassian Support Offerings (https://confluence.atlassian.com/support/atlassian-support-offerings-193299636.html). The 1-hour figure applies to the Premium plan (not Enterprise). Any old email referencing L1=1h for Enterprise is incorrect — the ARCHIVED_sla_matrix_v0.json also had this error and was superseded by v1.

[Slack #support-ops alice Mon Apr 01 10:30 UTC 2026] Correct. Bob, note that `ARCHIVED_sla_matrix_v0.json` was our pre-2024 version that had L1=1h — that was WRONG. Do not reference that file for current policy. The 30-minute figure is confirmed by the Atlassian docs. (ref: SLACK-PRD4-L1-CONFIRM)

Noted and recorded: Enterprise L1=30min is confirmed. `ARCHIVED_sla_matrix_v0.json` contained an erroneous L1=60min and was superseded by v1 effective 2024-01-01 (ref: SLACK-PRD4-L1-CONFIRM). I will not reference the archived file for policy decisions.

[Slack #support-ops alice Mon Apr 01 11:00 UTC 2026] Also, for the credit calculation: remember that under Atlassian Enterprise, there's a special tier for uptime between 99.90% and 99.95% — that gets a 5% credit. Premium plan doesn't have this tier.

Confirmed: Atlassian Enterprise has an exclusive 99.90%–99.95% tier with 5% credit (source: https://www.atlassian.com/legal/sla). Premium plan starts credit at < 99.90% only. I will apply this tier correctly in all credit calculations.
